title: Model only what real readers do
statement: In a modelled reading, show only actions a real reader takes on a text, such as rereading or highlighting, never crossing out or otherwise altering the passage.
detail: Review feedback of 11 August 2026 on a Grade 5 reference lesson asked the modelling step not to cross out passage text, since that is not an authentic reading action, and to model instead rereading each candidate, explaining why weaker evidence falls short, checking the rest of the text and selecting the best evidence. The course's criterion for narrated models asks that each highlight or visible action come with the spoken reasoning, and rejects text altered in a way readers would not normally use. The mapping implies no verdict on the current course.

evidence.quote: Do not cross out passage text when that is not an authentic reading action.
Model rereading each candidate, explaining why weaker evidence is insufficient, checking the remaining text, and selecting the best evidence.
Where a narrated model changes the text, does each highlight or visible action occur with the spoken reasoning while only essential durable cues remain onscreen?
text is altered in a way readers would not normally use
